evals.prompt: Use the audit skill. My product pages don't show rich results in Google. The Lighthouse SEO score is 72. In this session you have no project files and no shell, and nobody to ask. Do not ask questions: assume a typical Next.js App Router project and answer in text with concrete findings, what you would check, the fixes and the code you would write.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses missing Product structured data and meta tag issues, implements fixes
expectations: The answer checks the product pages for existing application/ld+json structured data
The answer checks that the structured data matches the visible page content
The answer validates the markup with the Rich Results Test
The answer checks that every page has a unique title and a unique description
The answer checks alternates.canonical on every page
The answer checks that the OG image is 1200x630
